name: 660. Azure and OpenRouter price a GPT cache write at the requested TTL, and an OpenRouter Claude write at its own (azure and openrouter cache ttl pricing)
description: TXE-7946, a follow-up to TXE-7069 (folders 646 and 654). Azure OpenAI on GPT-5.6 and later, and OpenRouter on OpenAI models, bill a cache write at the tier of the request's prompt_cache_options.ttl and report one cache_write_tokens figure with no split by TTL, so both are listed in RequestTTLPricedCacheWrites. OpenRouter applies prompt_cache_options to OpenAI models only, so its entry covers openai/* and a Claude write keeps its base rate. The fixture's pricing sheet has azure/gpt-fixture-cache-ttl and openrouter/openai/gpt-fixture-cache-ttl at $1/M input, $2/M output, $3/M cache write and $7.50/M above 12 hours, and openrouter/anthropic/claude-fixture-cache-ttl with $6/M above an hour. /pp/cachettl answers /v1/responses (and Azure's /openai/v1/responses) with 3,000 input tokens, 2,000 of them written to the cache, 200 output tokens and no usage.cost. At 12h that is $0.0164, and at 30m, or on the Claude row, $0.0074. Against a gateway without the change, rows 660.1 and 660.3 are logged at $0.0074.
